# Fork only: THE list of fork-owned paths, one pattern per line. A pull request whose every changed path is
# fork-owned skips Fork tests' app jobs (Build, Test, Test Web, Test Server, Rust, Release Smoke, macOS lint):
# none of them reads these files. A pull request that also changes other paths gets upstream's detector's answer for
# those other paths only (fork-owned ones left out), so it runs just the app jobs they affect. Read by .github/scripts/fork-owned-paths.cjs (the `changes` job) and its test.
#
#   folder/       everything under the folder
#   a/fork-*.py   one file; `*` matches any characters but `/`
#   !pattern      never fork-owned, even when a line above matches it (a file an app job reads)
#
# Fail closed: a path no line matches is not fork-owned, and the pull request runs every job. Never fork-owned,
# whatever this list says: this list, its script, every workflow and composite action, upstream's change detector,
# package and lock files and shared build config (fork-owned-paths.cjs, NEVER). A file an app job of fork-tests.yml
# names, or app code, a composite action or a `!` file reads, must be excluded here with `!` (fork-owned-paths.test.py
# checks the workflow, fork-owned-reads.test.py greps those files). Pushes to main and release runs always run every
# job.

# The fork's composite actions and host kits: only the `workflows`, `action_tests` and `kit_tests` jobs read them.
fork-ci/
fork-kit/
# The review rules' shared vectors and the gate's lens corpus: the server's review-rules test reads them, so a pull
# request changing the gate and its vectors runs that test too.
!fork-ci/actions/pr-queue/review.vectors.json
!fork-ci/actions/pr-queue/testdata/lens-corpus.jsonl

# The fork's scripts and settings under .github; the `workflows` job tests them.
.github/scripts/fork-*
.github/scripts/fork_*
.github/scripts/fork-fleet-walls/
.github/fork-*
# Read by app jobs or the runner routing every app job uses.
!.github/scripts/fork-fleet.py
!.github/scripts/fork-ci-pressure.py
!.github/scripts/fork-test-shards.cjs
!.github/fork-test-seconds.json
!.github/scripts/fork-vitest-gc-check.cjs
!.github/fork-fleet.json
!.github/fork-upstream-mobile-eas-preview-fork.yml

# The fork's changes list; fork-changes-list.test.cjs (the `workflows` job) checks it against forkDefaults.ts.
FORK_CHANGES.md

# The secret scan's settings; the `secrets` job runs on every pull request.
.gitleaks.toml
.gitleaksignore
